shared_or_similar_visual_information: A curved overlap region formed by intersecting circular outlines. On the left, use the tan lens labeled 79 inside both product-preference circles. On the right, use one of the gray curved components between the white central overlap and a pair of outer arcs.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens represents customers who prefer both product categories. Right image: The gray components consist of locations inside exactly two of the three circles. The center common to all three is unshaded.
Rationales: The left lens encodes joint membership in two named sets. The right gray region selects pieces of a geometric area by circle coverage.
